scientific_scope_status: Across four retained initial states, twelve continuations and two task families, ordinary warmW, ordinary freshF and equally fresh plus representation procedureR produced complementary scoped results. The completed source-exposed math/control reviews and unmasked mapping show no consistent added-procedure winner. Fresh ordinary equals or improves some common constructions, while warm/procedure contexts retain different valid restrictions and barriers. This is scoped research-method evidence, not a discovery-policy guarantee.
